name: Aquion Energy
title: Was Aquion Energy too early? No: lithium got cheaper
question: Was Aquion Energy too early for grid batteries?
answer: Aquion Energy made saltwater (aqueous sodium-ion) batteries for grid storage and filed for bankruptcy in March 2017. Its pitch was being cheaper and safer than lithium-ion, and lithium-ion then fell steeply in price. Like Solyndra, it was a cost-curve inversion: a later date would have been worse.
verdict_reason: Its pitch depended on lithium-ion staying expensive.

constraint.name: Bet that lithium-ion stays expensive
constraint.detail: Cheaper lithium-ion removed the reason to buy a different chemistry.
